meta.listSource: Official PlayStation trophy list as published on Exophase (https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/) and PSNProfiles (https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi), both read 2026-11-20. The two sources agree on every name, description and grade; PSNProfiles also gives the PSN progress target where one is shown. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is original writing for this entry, built only from the official descriptions plus the PSN targets; no walkthrough location or step is claimed beyond what those sources pin down, and anything not yet checked in the game is labelled as such.
meta.missableMethod: A trophy is flagged missable only where its official description names one specific story mission or a choice. That is a watch-list built from the descriptions alone: the game may offer mission replay, which is not confirmed, so treat flagged trophies as earn-it-when-you-see-it until replay is confirmed.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then strangers and side work, then collectibles and exploration, then the activity grind — and clear the missable watch-list during the story so nothing is left for a second playthrough.
